initialBuild.description:
Everything listed below is "in order" of priority

# DAMAGE PRESET

## TAB 1

- [[talent:6]] -> [[talent:5]] -> 50 points [[talent:448]] -> [[talent:446]] -> [[talent:1]] 
- [[talent:11]] (upgrade according to accuracy needed) -> [[talent:12]] -> [[talent:447]] -> [[talent:448]] -> [[talent:13]]

## TAB 2

- [[talent:457]] -> [[talent:455]] = [[talent:452]] -> 10 points [[talent:450]]  = 40 points [[talent:451]] 
- [[talent:456]] /depends on equpiment stats if high go Unt, if low go Ind/ [[talent:459]] -> [[talent:463]]

## TAB 3

- [[talent:485]] -> [[talent:488]] -> [[talent:494]] 
- 20 points [[talent:480]] = 20 points [[talent:481]] = 20 points[[talent:482]] -> [[talent:489]] (scales on bubble level)
- [[talent:490]] -> [[talent:491]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 1

- [[talent:620]] -> [[talent:616]] (capped at 10% of highest level - ie level 100 means skill level 10)
- [[talent:621]] = [[talent:624]] = [[talent:627]]
- Up to 30 points in [[talent:622]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 2

- [[talent:638]] (More dungeon = more damage) -> [[talent:631]] -> [[talent:634]] 
- 1 point in both [[talent:635]] and [[talent:639]]
- Optional: [[talent:632]] , [[talent:629]] [[talent:640]]

## TAB 3

- [[talent:492]] -> [[talent:491]]-> [[talent:493]]

## TAB 4

- [[talent:535]] -> [[talent:538]] -> [[talent:537]] -> [[talent:536]] 
- [[talent:533]] -> [[talent:532]] -> [[talent:539]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 1

- [[talent:621]] = [[talent:625]] = [[talent:620]]

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 2

- [[talent:636]] -> [[talent:637]] -> [[talent:631]] -> [[talent:634]] 
- 1 point in both [[talent:635]] and [[talent:639]]
